sarah.k: Quick heads-up — CVE sweep dug up a couple critical OpenSSL/glibc fixes that affect our minimal base images (ubuntu-minimal:22.04, alpine:3.19-slim). Proposal: do a constrained rebuild + rootless canary push, sign images with KMS, and run a 24h canary before rollouts. Need priority and sign-off on KMS flow.
matt.h: +1. Which images are in-scope? hosted-api runtime and dedicated-runtime pools should be first priority.
sarah.k: In-scope now: `ubuntu-minimal:22.04`, `ubuntu-lts-slim:22.04`, `alpine:3.19-slim`, and our internal `redwood/base:py3.11-min` derived from those. Hosted API uses `redwood/base:py3.11-min` in prod pools.
ana.p: (typo) ana.p: For KMS signing — do we want CI to call customer-managed KMS or our internal key for canonical builds? We need to avoid leaving signing keys in runners.
jen.r: We have an internal HSM-backed key in the signing cluster (signer01). CI will call the signing service over mTLS. I'll attach the signer playbook. Need to confirm RBAC: only `repo:infra/base-images` ci role can request signatures.
build-bot: build job queued: `base-rebuild/ubuntu-22.04@1804513500` — artifact: gs://redwood-ci/base-rebuild/1804513500.tar.gz :package:
luca.s: Testing note: recommend rootless containers for the canary nodes. Start with one node in canary pool, charge 1% weight via router, run traffic for 24h, then expand to 10% for 48h.
tom.b: Security checklist: (1) verify image signature against KMS public key; (2) enable container runtime seccomp profile; (3) audit log entries for image-pull+deploy must go to Splunk index `sec-audit`. Also we need to temporarily tighten RBAC so only `sre-canary` and `eng-security` can promote.
matt.h: Can we reuse nightly rebuild infra? We disabled nightly for ubuntu-minimal due to flaky tests. I'm ok with a forced rebuild pipeline with extra post-build smoke tests: `python -m pytest tests/smoke/container_start.py --trace` and `integration/kvcache_basic`.
sarah.k: Action items: 1) jen to enable CI pipeline + connect to signer01 (jen.r) 2) matt to re-enable constrained rebuild with smoke tests (matt.h) 3) ana to document KMS key rotation and public key publish path (ana.p) 4) luca to schedule canary: 24h @1%, then 48h @10% (luca.s) 5) tom to push RBAC change and audit filter (tom.b). Please ping `#incidents` if any regression.
ana.p: I'll add KMS rotation docs to `confluence/security/keys` and include the verification script: ```bash
# verify image signature
gcloud kms keys versions list --key=redwood-image-signing --location=global
docker pull gcr.io/redwood/base:py3.11-min-signed
./tools/verify-signature --image gcr.io/redwood/base:py3.11-min-signed --pubkey gs://redwood-keys/redwood-image-signing.pub
```
jen.r: Note on audit logging: CI signer events are already forwarded to `signer-audit` stream. Need to add a `deploy` webhook from `orchestrator` -> `sec-audit` with `image_digest` and `signer_key_id` fields. I'll open a PR for the webhook.
sarah.k: Thx. Risk note: alpine musl builds sometimes surface glibc-specific behavior in our downstream libs. We'll run the full compat matrix in staging: `ubuntu/alpine x py3.11/py3.10 x arm64/amd64`.
luca.s: Canary checklist: healthcheck `/readyz`, tokenized sample prompts (hosted-api smoke), and memory/cpu profiling for 3 token bursts. If errors >0.5% rollback immediately.
matt.h: ETA: will have first rebuild artifacts by EOD tomorrow. If anyone has critical prod pins (images that cannot change), comment with image digest; we'll skip them from auto-promote.
tom.b: Also add a short incident-runbook snippet for this vuln class under `playbooks/container-cve-rollout.md` — include rollback commands and how to revoke signed manifests.
sarah.k: Great — let's treat this as P1 on infra-security board for 48h. Reply with :thumbsup: once you've got your ticket. I'll follow up with a short sync in 1h.
jen.r: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-infra/repo/pull/412 — adds signer webhook. cc @tom.b :eyes:
matt.h: :thumbsup: I'll post build logs to the thread when done.
build-bot: build completed: `base-rebuild/ubuntu-22.04@1804514200` status=SUCCESS size=128MB sha256=3f2a...a9
sarah.k: Received — leaving this thread open for rollback/observability notes. Thanks all.
